## Change and rationale

Describe the problem, scope and compatibility impact. Link a non-security issue if relevant.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added/updated; relevant full suite and quality gates passed.
- [ ] M7 deterministic baseline passed for runtime/security/verification changes.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated where appropriate.
- [ ] No real credentials, private data or generated artifacts included.
- [ ] Compatibility and failure paths considered; security boundaries are not overstated.

Do not submit undisclosed vulnerability details here; follow SECURITY.md.
